events.subtitle: Standalone headline show during the 2026 Gorillaz support run

en.why_it_matters: The standalone room is the point. Del, Dan the Automator and Kid Koala spend most of this fall run supporting Gorillaz in arenas, but Baltimore gets one of the separately announced headline dates, putting the project's full concept-rap, production and turntable architecture in the foreground. That makes Soundstage a much more revealing way to hear this trio than a shortened support slot.
en.trip_verdict: From the DMV, this is worth a dedicated Baltimore night if the original trio's production-and-turntablism thread is the draw. The club-headliner format is the reason to choose Soundstage rather than simply catching Deltron 3030 in arena support the following night in Washington.

Soundstage ofrece una forma mucho más reveladora de escuchar al trío que un set recortado de soporte.
es.trip_verdict: Desde el DMV, sí da para una salida dedicada a Baltimore si el hilo que importa es el trío original y su trabajo de producción y turntablism. El formato de club como headliner es la razón para escoger Soundstage en vez de limitarse a ver a Deltron 3030 como soporte en Washington la noche siguiente.
